title: AFTERIMAGE / CITY FUTURES
disclaimer: This is a civic research layer, not political advice or an electoral forecast. Source evidence, plans and conditional scenarios remain distinct. No issue scores, endorsement or inferred impacts. Place pins identify publicly sourced offices, not policy effect boundaries.

issues.title: New City Council, new decision timeline
issues.summary: Mayor Pete Fry and ten councillors began their 2026–2030 term on November 2. The ceremony was at the Orpheum, not City Hall.
issues.watch: Watch published agendas, minutes, budgets, and votes. A speech is not a recorded decision.
issues.scenario: IF major policies change during this term, compare actual decisions with the previous adopted plan; do not infer anyone's motivations.

issues.title: 83,000 housing approvals: a target, not a prediction
issues.summary: The City's adopted 2024–2033 goal is 83,000 housing approvals. It reported 12,795 approvals in 2025; approvals and completed dwellings are different metrics.
issues.watch: Compare annual approvals with completions and non-market share. Use permit issuance only for what it actually measures.
issues.scenario: IF approvals grow without comparable completions, access and affordability might not change at the same pace. Compare evidence before drawing conclusions.

issues.title: Broadway Subway: a 2027 milestone
issues.summary: The Broadway Subway is an extension of the Millennium Line with six new underground stations, scheduled to open in 2027.
issues.watch: Track official opening notices, service changes and neighbouring development records.
issues.scenario: IF service begins in 2027, measure subsequent mobility and local business changes against earlier baseline data. Proximity is not evidence of causation.

issues.title: The cost of keeping creative space alive
issues.summary: Cultural Operating Funding – Spaces applications opened November 2, with a December 10, 2026 deadline for eligible arts-space operators. Individual artists are not generally direct applicants.
issues.watch: Check eligibility, deadlines, awarded projects and cultural space capacity, not just headline grant amounts.
issues.scenario: IF more eligible spaces receive support, compare documented access and affordability outcomes. A grant award does not guarantee new facilities.

issues.title: The 30-year development plan enters its next chapter
issues.summary: Vancouver adopted its Official Development Plan March 31, 2026. The plan provides a land-use framework and does not itself rezone any individual lot.
issues.watch: Track ODP amendments, individual rezoning decisions, issued permits and the 2030 review.
issues.scenario: IF implementation changes local land use, link outcomes only to specific parcels or published neighbourhood statistics, not a guessed citywide effect.
